blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: adjacency list — Neighbours indexed by vertex.

blocks.title: Discover
blocks.text: An adjacency list records each vertex and its neighbours. For undirected graphs, an edge is represented in both vertices' neighbour lists.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: For BFS, enqueue a starting vertex, mark it visited, and repeatedly dequeue and enqueue undiscovered neighbours.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Traversal order depends on neighbour ordering. A visited set prevents infinite revisiting when the graph contains cycles.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the trace
blocks.text: With B before C, BFS visit order A,B,C,D. Each vertex is marked on enqueue.
